I implemented the audit requirement in the owner create flow (`addOwner` in `OwnerRestControllerV1.java`):

- Added a dedicated SLF4J logger named `AUDIT` (`LoggerFactory.getLogger("AUDIT")`) — matching the name the acceptance harness captures.
- After a successful `saveOwner`, it emits one line carrying the owner id, `customerCode`, and `registrationDate`:
  ```
  AUDIT - Owner created: id=11 customerCode=TOW-SUR-0001 registrationDate=2026-10-05
  ```

The line is emitted only on the successful-create path (after all validation/quota checks and the save), so it reflects the persisted owner — including the generated `customerCode` and the business-day-resolved `registrationDate`. The full test suite passes (`BUILD SUCCESS`, including `AcceptanceTest.coreLogsAuditOnCreate`).
